dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric expansion from the anterior blowhole region reaching maximum width at the mid-section, followed by a gradual and consistent linear narrowing toward the visible posterior region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Mainly smooth lateral margins with a subtle, non-uniform convex bulge on the right margin relative to the mid-axial line.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median intensity across the dorsal plane, indicating a sub-adult or transitioning adult maturation phase.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse grey mottling appearing as irregular patches, most notable on the lower-left dorsal quadrant and near the posterior taper.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient slopes with low contrast between the pigmented mottled patches and the lighter baseline epidermal tone.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, light-colored longitudinal linear striations (rake marks) visible on the mid-right and central dorsal surface; single small circular dark spot on the left-posterior region.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Primary anatomical indentation at the blowhole; no unnatural geometric deformations or shadow-casting blunt trauma visible.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed longitudinal rake marks consisting of parallel, narrow, pale lines across the mid-dorsal plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced dark-pixel circular aperture of the blowhole at the anterior-most visible section.
